parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Pour 200 cm 3 of hot water into the beaker. Place the thermometer in the beaker of hot water. • Record in Table 2.1 the temperature θ of the hot water at time t = 0 s. Immediately start the stopclock. • After 30 s, measure the temperature θ shown on the thermometer. Record the time t = 30 s and the temperature reading in the table. • Continue recording the time and temperature readings every 30 s until you have six sets of readings. [2] Table 2.1 t / s θ / °C 0
